peer_results.rationale: The provided candidate disclosures (amd_2024_1_D021 and amd_2024_1_D020) focus on server CPUs, GPUs, and AI accelerators as compute engines. They do not disclose specific storage products or storage-centric strategies comparable to Micron's SSD offerings for AI data lakes.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides advanced technology and IP platforms for customers to design ASICs targeting AI, high-performance computing, and networking applications.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies address the demand for AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. Micron focuses on the storage layer, specifically supplying high-performance SSDs (6500 and 9550 series) optimized for AI data lakes and HPC workloads. Broadcom provides the custom silicon (ASIC) platform that integrates logic, memory, and processor cores to enable customers to build specialized chips for AI and HPC applications. While Micron provides the physical storage media and controllers, Broadcom provides the underlying silicon design IP and platforms for custom AI/HPC accelerators.

sentences.text: Our 6500 30TB SSDs features high performance, reliability, and endurance for AI data lake applications.
In 2024, we began sampling our 9550 series SSD to meet the growing demands of AI, high-performance computing, and many other workloads.

• Custom Silicon Solutions: We provide advanced technology and intellectual property ("IP") platforms for customers to design and develop application specific integrated circuits ("ASICs") targeting AI and high-performance computing, networking and storage applications. Our custom silicon provides the platform to integrate embedded logic, memory, serializer/deserializer ("SerDes") technology, IP cores and processor cores. ASICs are custom products built to individual customers specifications.

comparisons.peer_topic: Hardware Foundation: GPUs, DPUs, and CPUs
comparisons.peer_summary: The platform is founded on GPUs for parallel workloads, expanded in fiscal year 2022 to include DPUs and in fiscal year 2024 to include CPUs, allowing optimization across the computing, networking, and storage stack.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures describe the comprehensive nature of their data center offerings which span multiple hardware stack layers for AI and HPC. Micron highlights its storage solutions (SSDs) as part of the integrated solution for data centers requiring high performance and capacity for AI. NVIDIA describes its platform foundation including GPUs, DPUs, and CPUs that allow optimization across the entire 'computing, networking and storage stack.' Both emphasize delivering optimized performance for these specific workloads.

sentences.text: Data center: The growing use of cloud computing and big data analytics is fueling the demand for high performance storage in data centers.
This fully integrated solution enables improved performance, power efficiency, and security features for data center operators.
Beyond GPUs, our data center platform expanded to include DPUs in fiscal year 2022 and CPUs in fiscal year 2024.
We can optimize across the entire computing, networking and storage stack to deliver data center-scale computing solutions.
